Takes one full name such as yourbrand.com.ng. When it can be ordered online, gives the first-year price. Prices are in

tools.name: list_esim_locations
tools.description: List every country and region we sell eSIM data plans for, with their codes. Regions (for example Europe or Global) cover many countries in one eSIM.

tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: eSIM data plans for one destination, cheapest first, with prices. No sign-up: the person orders, pays, and gets an eSIM QR code. Give a country or region name or code, for example "United Kingdom", "GB" or "Europe". Each plan has an order_url: our own order page for the person. Prices are in US doll

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search what Xpress sells: eSIM destinations by name. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full details for one id returned by search, for example esim:GB (every plan and price for that destination). Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

tools.name: search_phone_plans
tools.description: eSIMs with a real carrier phone number (calls, texts and data), with prices. Optional country: US, VN, AU, MN, MV, EU (Europe) or GLOBAL. Each plan has an order_url for the person. Non-refundable once bought. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

tools.name: create_domain_order
tools.description: Start an order to register an available domain for a person. This does not charge anyone. It returns an approval_url that the person must open and pay (in US dollars outside Nigeria, in naira in Nigeria); the name is held for 60 minutes. Send approval_url to your user and wait. Poll get_order_status

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Look up an order made with create_domain_order, create_esim_order or create_proxy_order. tools.name: list_proxy_products
tools.description: Proxy products with packs and prices, cheapest first. Each pack has an offer_id for create_proxy_order. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

tools.name: create_proxy_order
tools.description: Start a proxy purchase for a person. This does not charge anyone: it returns payment_url for the person to pay, in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria. After a verified payment the proxies are issued within 10 minutes. Poll get_order_status with reference and status_token.

tools.name: create_cart_order
tools.description: Start one purchase for several eSIMs and proxy packs together: one payment_url for the whole total, in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria. This does not charge anyone. After a verified payment every item is delivered within 1 hour. Returns each item reference with its own status_url.

tools.name: get_cart_status
tools.description: Look up a cart made with create_cart_order: the cart status and each item with its own status_url. tools.name: request_email_code
tools.description: Step 1 before any create_*_order: email a 6-digit code to the buyer. Ask your user for the code from that email (it expires in 10 minutes; a new one can be sent after 60 seconds, at most 5 an hour).

tools.name: verify_email_code
tools.description: Step 2: check the 6-digit code your user read from their email. Returns verification_token (valid 24 hours); pass it as email_verification_token to create_domain_order, create_esim_order or create_proxy_order with the same email. 5 tries per code.

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create an empty Xpress wallet (no sign-up, no free credit). Returns a 32-character wallet code and an xk_live_ API key, shown once. Fund it with create_deposit on /api/mcp/wallet, then buy domains and eSIMs from the wallet balance within the caps the wallet owner sets.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_email_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_esim_order, verify_email_code · Private data: create_wallet · Public sink: create_domain_order, create_esim_order, request_email_code, verify_email_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_esim_order, verify_email_code · Private data: create_wallet · Public sink: create_domain_order, create_esim_order, request_email_code, verify_email_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_order_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up an order made with create_domain_order, create_esim_order or create_proxy_order. Domain statuses: awaiting_payment, paid (being registered), registered, needs_attention, refunded, expired, cancelled. Statuses: awaiting_approval (phone-number order held for a manual ID check; nothing charged;" → after: "Look up an order made with create_domain_order, create_esim_order or create_proxy_order. Statuses: pending_payment (waiting for payment; for a phone-number order held for an ID check, payment_url appears once approved and nothing is charged before that), paid, activating (paid and being prepared, de"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
